description: Overnight Calm | Santoor Sleep Music | 3 Hours of slow, resonant santoor to carry you through the whole night.
Three hours of warm, unhurried santoor in Raga Bilawal, played soft and slow, with nothing sudden and nothing to wait for — just a deep bed of sound to sink into and stay asleep till morning.
🎧 HOW TO USE — low volume, screen off. Loops seamlessly all night.
⏱ BEST FOR — falling asleep · staying asleep all night · deep rest · unwinding into sleep
🎵 ABOUT — the santoor's hammered strings, played slow and soft, become a different instrument at night — deep, resonant, and settling.
